source: applied rewrites from the independent-critic rounds on data/aggregates/hero-coach-critique.json (rounds 1-2), kept so a re-ingest of the same authored line reproduces the JUDGED text instead of reverting to the pre-judge draft; each fix is re-verified by copy-verify against the current facts before it is applied

adele:support.Open with Imperial Lash to root and dash: After a teammate commits, Imperial Lash to root and dash onto their carry, then drop Queen’s Garden under them so allies cash in the Thorns bonus. Once Stonewall and Warden's Faith finish by minute 21, keep Iron Rose up and stand in front.

akeron:jungle.Khaimera, Kwang and Feng Mao win the str: Khaimera, Kwang and Feng Mao win the straight fight, so clear your own camps and gank sidelanes instead of invading into them — Rampage and Boris are fights you can take.

argus:support.Peel with Ether Crystal: it shoves diver: Use Ether Crystal to protect your carry: it shoves attackers off them, then pulls them back in as it implodes, and follow with Dread Nova to stun. Stonewall and Warden's Faith by minute 21 let you block for them instead of backing away.
argus:support.Riktor, Dekker, Mourn and Narbash win th: Riktor, Dekker, Mourn and Narbash win this lane on our sim; hide behind minions and drop Ether Crystal on your carry to push divers off them.
argus:support.Wait for their engage, then lob Dread No: Wait for their engage, then lob Dread Nova to stun and place Ether Crystal under your carry to push divers off and lift your carry into the air. Once Stonewall lands, stand closer and channel Synaptic Obliterator after the enemy uses their dashes.

aurora:offlane.Greystone, Steel and Zarus beat you earl: Greystone, Steel and Zarus beat you early, so hold Glacial Charge as an escape and farm until your team can join you.

aurora:support.Engaging before your carry is in range l: Engaging before your carry is in range leaves you alone behind their team, so wait until they can follow you in before you use Glacial Charge.
aurora:support.Dekker wins this lane on our sim; don't: Dekker wins this lane on our sim; don't trade into her, stay by your carry and root her with Hoarfrost when she engages.

countess:midlane.Gideon and The Fey out-range you, so nev: Gideon and The Fey out-range you, so never Shadow Slip in without saving the swap to get you back out.

countess:jungle.Kwang wins the straight fight, so clear: Kwang wins the straight fight, so stay off his side of the jungle — invade into Serath, Rampage, Boris or Feng Mao instead, and keep the Shadow to slip out.
countess:jungle.Dive a grouped team and Shadow Slip won': Dive a grouped team and Shadow Slip won't save you — swap back to the Shadow early, or wait until you catch someone alone.

gideon:midlane.Black Hole can't be cancelled once cast: Once Black Hole has finished channelling it can't be cancelled — don't open with it alone; wait for a teammate's stun or the enemy to commit first.
gideon:midlane.Open with Void Breach to slow them, foll: Open with Void Breach to slow them, follow with Cosmic Rift, then land a basic attack — Cosmic Power tethers and roots them for the follow-up. Use Torn Space to reposition; once Caustica lands at minute 24, Black Hole finishes fights.
gideon:midlane.Black Hole roots you in place while it c: While you channel Black Hole you stay in place; if their team can still stun you, wait until they're spent.
gideon:midlane.Black Hole roots you in place while chan: Black Hole keeps you channeling for 2.75s before you can act; cast it only after the enemy has used their dashes and stuns.

greystone:offlane.Steel and Zarus win this lane — Stone Fo: Steel and Zarus win this lane — once you have spent Stone Forged Soul to heal up, back off instead of staying for another trade.
greystone:offlane.Steel and Zarus win this lane — once you: Zarus wins this lane — once you have spent Stone Forged Soul to heal up, back off instead of staying for another trade.

greystone:jungle.Gank with Assault The Gates — hitting a: Gank with Assault The Gates — hitting a hero cuts its cooldown — then Make Way to shred armor and Sacred Oath to cleave. Stone Forged Soul heals you back up when a dive goes wrong; Krix adds tankiness, not damage.

iggy-scorch:offlane.Lay Flame Turrets in the bushes, then Oi: Lay Flame Turrets in the bushes, then Oil Spill across the lane and ignite it with Molotov to hold them off the wave. Basic attacks stack Slick for extra burn; Wraith Leggings by minute 25 lets you walk away from whoever jumps you.
iggy-scorch:offlane.Melee bruisers kill turrets fast — when: Melee bruisers kill turrets fast — when one jumps you, save Inferno's knockback to shove them off you rather than burning it for damage.

kwang:offlane.Poke with Judgement of the Heavens, then: Poke with Judgement of the Heavens, then Surge of the Heavens into the blade to snap it back and knock them up. Landing an ability Energizes your blade, and the lightning basic attack that follows cuts your cooldowns; by minute 24 you can stand in the fight and keep swinging.

lt-belica:midlane.Against Gideon, The Fey, Countess or Igg: Gideon, The Fey, Countess and Iggy & Scorch all come out ahead in this lane, so hold Seismic Assault for their engage and farm safely.

lt-belica:support.Against Dekker you lose the checkpoint t: Dekker comes out ahead in this lane, so stop walking up for Seismic Assault and use Void Drone for vision while your carry farms.

murdock:carry.Drop Static Trap on the path they must w: Drop Static Trap on the path they must walk, then use Buckshot as they step in for the armor shred — it pushes them back, so keep your distance and keep basic attacking with Hot Pursuit up. Once Viper and Deathstalker are done by minute 19 those attack chains kill on their own.
murdock:carry.This build's opener is a sim blind spot: Players who open with Viper have lost more often, so if lane goes badly, switch to the build most carries use.

murdock:offlane.Greystone, Steel, Aurora and Zarus all w: Greystone, Steel, Aurora and Zarus all come out ahead in this lane, so give up the wave, farm under tower and ask your jungler for help.

shinbi:offlane.Poke with Line Tempo, then dash in with: Poke with Line Tempo, then dash in with Rushing Beat and turn on Circle Rhythm for the shield while your wolves chew on them. Every ability that damages a hero builds Track — at 8 stacks cash it in with All-Kill! — and Spectral Schematics and Timewarp by minute 19 make that rotation hit harder.
shinbi:offlane.If Greystone or Steel survives your comb: If Greystone or Steel survives your combo, don't stay to finish; leave with the Rushing Beat charge you saved.

sparrow:carry.Most enemy carries beat you early — if M: Most enemy carries come out ahead in this lane — if Murdock, Drongo or Eden are pushing the wave into you, farm safely with Piercing Shot instead of trading basic attacks.

terra:offlane.Wild Rush's long channel gets punished b: Greystone, Steel, Aurora and Zarus all come out ahead in this lane, and Wild Rush needs up to a 3.5s wind-up, so don't open fights with it — use it to escape or follow up.
terra:offlane.Trade with Highland Hurl to slow, then R: Trade with Highland Hurl to slow, then Ruthless Assault up close to stack Hersir so your next ability is empowered. After Viper and Deathstalker by minute 16, engage with Wild Rush and use Unstoppable Force to cleanse and disable enemy towers while you push.

yin:jungle.Open with Q Lash Kick to yank yourself o: Open with Q Lash Kick to yank yourself onto them and slow them hard, turn on E Windburn for the extra range and cleave, then keep attacking — Windburn's passive makes every third attack in a row deal bonus damage and heal you. Solaris, Viper and Spear Of Desolation by minute 25 make that chain finish kills.
yin:jungle.You lose most even jungle duels — use RM: You lose most jungle duels head-on — use RMB Backlash to turn away their shots and only fight when a teammate is already there.

gadget:midlane.Root them with Security Gate, stick Stic: Root them with Security Gate, stick Sticky Mine on and land a Spark basic attack so the mine goes off empowered for the bigger hit, then Seek and Destroy as they run. Once Orion and Wraith Leggings land you can commit Tesla Dome on top.
gadget:midlane.Gideon and The Fey win this matchup — ho: Gideon wins this matchup and The Fey is even — hold Security Gate for their engage and farm safely instead of trading mines.

mourn:support.Open with Abduct to drag someone out of: Open with Abduct to drag someone out of position, follow with Beguile to hold them, then Contagion to heal your carry and strip their armor. Between fights chip at them from range instead of committing; Oblivion Crown lands at minute 29.

rampage:jungle.Khaimera, Kwang and Kallari take the che: Khaimera, Kwang and Kallari all beat you in a straight fight — don't duel them without Behemoth up; farm and gank the lanes instead.
rampage:jungle.Clear camps fast, then carry Boulder Thr: Clear camps fast, then carry Boulder Throw into a lane, stun your target, and follow with Pounce and Rumble to slow them. Once Spear Of Desolation is done around minute 15, use Behemoth to stay alive in fights.

scarlett:offlane.Zarus wins the checkpoints — don't burn: Zarus comes out ahead in a straight fight — don't burn First Intent to engage him; keep it as the escape and shield refresh.
scarlett:offlane.Dash in with First Intent, lock the targ: Dash in with First Intent, then land Ashen Vow and Minueta's stabs, and use Swan Song to restrain a target that tries to run; your blade stays Ablaze afterward for extra stabs. After Resolution and The Perforator by minute 16, aim your combo at squishy targets, not the enemy frontline.

scarlett:jungle.Kwang wins the checkpoints — don't invad: Kwang comes out ahead in a straight fight — don't invade him early; take your own camps and gank a lane where Swan Song can catch someone.
scarlett:jungle.Gank from behind with First Intent, lock: Gank from behind with First Intent, then land Ashen Vow and Minueta's stabs, and use Swan Song to restrain a target that tries to run; your blade stays Ablaze afterward for extra stabs. After Resolution and The Perforator by minute 16, hunt squishy laners instead of fighting the frontline head-on.

sevarog:offlane.Greystone, Steel, Aurora and Zarus win t: Greystone, Steel, Aurora and Zarus all beat you in a straight fight — farm Souls safely and fight only with Subjugate up.
sevarog:offlane.Finish minions with Siphon to collect So: Finish minions with Siphon to collect Souls, and trade by landing Subjugate first, then Phantom Rush through them for the fear. After Orion and Timewarp by minute 16, follow Subjugate with Colossal Blow when it's ready to hit whoever is caught.

sevarog:jungle.Don't invade Khaimera or Kwang early — t: Don't invade Khaimera or Kwang early — they beat you in a straight fight; take your own camps and gank the lanes instead.

steel:support.Dekker wins the lane checkpoints — don't: Dekker beats you in a straight fight — don't engage first; hold Shield Slam until after she commits and use it to protect your carry.

zinx:offlane.Open with Ricochet to stun, drop Bad Med: Open with Ricochet to stun, drop Bad Medicine under them for the slow and second burst, then keep basic attacking — Refibrillator's burn stacks on every hit and keeps ticking. Oathkeeper lands at minute 19.
zinx:offlane.Every offlane checkpoint here goes to th: Every offlane matchup here goes against you — farm safe, use Infuse and Neural Regenesis to keep allies alive, and don't duel.
zinx:offlane.Poke with Ricochet and Bad Medicine, and: Poke with Ricochet and Bad Medicine, then back off between trades instead of trading health. After Combustion and Noxia by minute 16, hit squishy targets from behind your frontline.
zinx:offlane.Poke with Ricochet and Bad Medicine, the: Poke with Ricochet and Bad Medicine from range, then back off before they can hit you back. After Combustion and Noxia by minute 16, hit squishy targets from behind your frontline.

zinx:midlane.Every midlane checkpoint goes to the ene: Every midlane matchup here goes against you — don't trade on your own; play behind your jungler and win fights with Infuse and the revive.
zinx:midlane.Clear the wave with Bad Medicine, then p: Clear the wave with Bad Medicine, then poke with Ricochet when it can bounce off minions into them. After Combustion and Noxia by minute 15, join side-lane fights.

revenant:carry.Reckoning locks you alone with the targe: Reckoning locks you alone with the target, so pulling Sparrow, Skylar or Drongo, who beat you head-on, hands them the kill.

riktor:jungle.Khaimera and Kwang beat you at the check: Khaimera and Kwang beat you in a straight fight, so don't duel them for camps; take the far side and gank a lane instead.

serath:jungle.Khaimera, Kwang, Feng Mao and Kallari al: Khaimera, Kwang, Feng Mao and Kallari all beat you in a straight fight, so don't invade early; farm your own camps until Heresy is up.
serath:jungle.Khaimera, Kwang and Rampage win the stra: Khaimera and Kwang win the straight duel, so skip their camps and gank lanes instead of fighting them in the jungle.

adele:offlane.Trade with Imperial Lash to root, then R: Trade with Imperial Lash to root, then Royal Flourish to hold them still and Queen’s Garden to pin them for the kill. With Viper and Deathstalker done by minute 19, that chain actually kills squishies; before then, farm behind Iron Rose.

akeron:offlane.Open with Web Lash to root, close in for: Open with Web Lash to root, close in for Crushing Maw at point-blank where it hits hardest and heals you, then Consume to pull and finish a low target. Crescelia by minute 23 makes Hellfire's chip worth poking with.
akeron:offlane.Poke with Hellfire, then Web Lash to roo: Poke with Hellfire, then Web Lash to root and follow with Crushing Maw up close to heal and build Hunger. Once Crescelia is done around minute 14, use Consume to pull a low target in and bite them for the execute.

aurora:jungle.Kwang is the coin-flip here, so skip the: Kwang beats you here, so skip the solo invade and take that fight only with your laner beside you.

bayle:jungle.Gank with Skull Crusher for the shred, f: Gank with Skull Crusher for the shred, follow with Cursed Edge so the third slash stuns, and cast Dire Howl before you take damage so it heals you afterwards. Viper and Spear Of Desolation by minute 18 turn Kingslayer into the finisher.

feng-mao:jungle.Open with Reaping Dash to close, land Ha: Open with Reaping Dash to close, land Hamstring's double swing on one target for its bonus damage, then finish with Earth Shatter's execute. Save Safeguard to block their key ability; once Viper and Augmentation land around minute 19, your ganks kill outright.
feng-mao:jungle.Gank with Reaping Dash, then Hamstring o: Gank with Reaping Dash, then Hamstring on a single target to slow and hit harder, holding Safeguard to block their key ability. Once The Perforator is done near minute 16, finish with Earth Shatter to execute and recast it after executing a hero.

feng-mao:offlane.Trade with Hamstring when only one enemy: Trade with Hamstring when only one enemy is in range — the single-target hit swings harder — then Reaping Dash in for the kill and hold Earth Shatter to execute. After Viper and Augmentation land by minute 19, your all-in actually finishes them.
feng-mao:offlane.Trade with Hamstring on the lone laner a: Trade with Hamstring on the lone laner and block their best ability with Safeguard. Once The Perforator is done near minute 16, close with Reaping Dash and execute with Earth Shatter; the takedown cuts Reaping Dash's cooldown so you can dash again.

kallari:jungle.Approach in Shadow Walk, open with Cripp: Approach in Shadow Walk, open with Crippling Dagger to slow, then Shadow Dance onto the marked target — it hits twice as hard on a Death Mark — and Guillotine when they're low. After Viper and Spear Of Desolation land by minute 18, the burst kills outright.

narbash:support.Toggle Song Of My People to healing in l: Toggle Song Of My People to healing in lane and speed when you rotate, then land Thunk's stun to start a trade. Once Noxia and Oblivion Crown land by minute 22, March! and Crash Bang Boom! turn a group fight your way.

twinblast:carry.Most enemy carries win the straight trad: Murdock and Drongo win the straight trade — poke with Vaporize from max range and only step up when their abilities are spent.

wukong:jungle.Open ganks in Spirit stance with RMB Win: Open ganks in Spirit stance with RMB Windsurge to close and slow, then E Cyclebreaker for the stun and keep hitting — every fifth hit spawns a Clone. Switch stances with R 84000 Hairs mid-fight; Solaris and Augmentation by minute 25 sharpen the burst.
wukong:jungle.Dash in with RMB Windsurge in Spirit sta: Dash in with RMB Windsurge in Spirit stance, throw E Cyclebreaker to stun, then switch stance with R and keep basic attacking to spawn Clones. Once Viper and Solaris are done around minute 16, use Q Pole Vault in Body stance to leap onto the enemy damage dealers standing at the back.
wukong:jungle.Gank by dashing in with Windsurge, then: Gank by dashing in with Windsurge, then use Cyclebreaker's damage reduction as they fight back; every 5 hits on enemies spawns a clone, and 84000 Hairs switches your stance. After The Perforator and Spear Of Desolation by minute 16, hunt squishy targets.

renna:midlane.Abyssal Rift's channel drops you into th: Abyssal Rift takes a 1.5s channel before it teleports you, so start it before you are in trouble and pick the landing spot — it will not save you once Gideon is already on you.

steel:offlane.Open with Bull Rush to knock them back i: Open with Bull Rush to close and knock them back, follow with Shield Bash for the stun, and put Force Shield in their escape path for the slow. Oathkeeper at minute 19 adds damage to that chain.

wraith:midlane.Poke with RMB Knock, Knock! from long ra: Poke with RMB Knock, Knock! from long range and clear minions with it, then commit only after Q Peekaboo! lands — the mark makes that shot hit far harder. Viper and Deathstalker by minute 18 make that pair actually kill.

boris:jungle.Mark a target with Detection Protocol, f: Mark a target with Detection Protocol, follow the trail in, Chrono Swipe through them, then Primeval Roar to fear and Ursine Burst to grab and slam them. After Deathstalker lands around minute 16, stick to squishy targets in short fights.

crunch:jungle.Gank with Forward Crunch to stun, then R: Gank with Forward Crunch to stun, then Right Crunch to slow and Left Crunch to hit hard, with a basic attack between each to lower cooldowns. After Basilisk lands around minute 16, use Re-Crunch right after your strongest hit to repeat it.

ikra:carry.You beat every listed carry on our sim,: You beat every listed carry on our sim, but a missed Narcosis leaves you open to divers; back off until it's ready again.

Slow them with E Data Burst, send Q L.I.N.X through them, then dash with RMB Erase Vector for an empowered Jolt; after three abilities, your next one gets Overclocked. Once Spectral Schematics and Oathkeeper are done around minute 16, chain R Final Thread into its recast bomb.

phase:support.Against Riktor, Dekker, Mourn or Narbash: Against Riktor, Dekker, Mourn or Narbash, stay behind your carry and reactivate Telekinetic Link to pull them out before they get stunned or rooted.

the-fey:support.Before your tank items land you are frag: Before your tank items land you are fragile; if you wander ahead of your carry you get caught alone and killed, so stay with them and poke.

zarus:jungle.Leaping in with Coliseum before your tea: Leaping in with Coliseum before your team arrives gets you surrounded and killed; wait for a teammate and keep Evade to escape.

argus:midlane.Poke with Particle Shredder, then lob Dr: Poke with Particle Shredder, then lob Dread Nova to stun and follow with Ether Crystal so the storm stacks Disintegrate. After Spectral Schematics and Timewarp, start Synaptic Obliterator only from a safe spot once their divers have used their engage.

crunch:offlane.Dash in with Forward Crunch, then weave: Dash in with Forward Crunch, then weave a basic attack after each ability so Cross Crunch empowers it, using Right Crunch to slow them. Once Viper and Basilisk are done, cast Re-Crunch right after Right Crunch to repeat its slow as they try to escape.
crunch:offlane.Weave a basic attack after every ability: Weave a basic attack after every ability to cut your cooldowns, and spend Turbo Crunch on an empowered Right Crunch to knock them up. Once Spear Of Desolation is done near minute 16, cast Re-Crunch right after your strongest ability, since it repeats the last ability you used.

howitzer:midlane.Lay H11 Cluster Grenades ahead of the wa: Lay H11 Cluster Grenades ahead of the wave, lob Land Mine behind your target to knock them into the grenades, then fire a charged R2000 Missile. Once Spirit Of Amir is done, weave a basic attack between casts so Armed Salvo refills your mana.

iggy-scorch:support.Melee divers break turrets fast; against: Against Dekker, which is theirs on our read, keep turrets behind you and save Inferno's knockback for her engage.
iggy-scorch:support.Dekker wins this lane on our read; stop: Dekker wins this lane on our read; stop trading forward and keep Oil Spill to slow anyone who dives your carry.

khaimera:jungle.Kwang wins this matchup on our read: do: Kwang wins this matchup on our read: do not duel him early; take camps on the other side.
khaimera:jungle.Jump in with Ambush to slow them, Unleas: Jump in with Ambush to slow them, Unleash for fast attacks, and press Invigorate when you are slowed or low to cleanse and heal. With Alternator and Manta Scythe done, save Cull for grouped or fleeing enemies, since it stuns everyone in front of you.

kwang:jungle.This build's opener is a sim blind spot: Players who open with Orion have lost slightly more than they've won; if you fall behind early, switch to the build most players use.
kwang:jungle.If Judgement of the Heavens misses, you: If Judgement of the Heavens misses, keep Surge of the Heavens to get out instead of face-tanking the whole enemy team.
kwang:jungle.Throw Judgement of the Heavens to tether: Throw Judgement of the Heavens to tether them, dash through with Surge of the Heavens to recall the blade, then Light of the Heavens to hit and shield. After Orion and Prophecy, keep the blade energized, and throw it ahead first so Fury of the Heavens teleports you in.

rampage:support.Stun a target with Boulder Throw, then P: Stun a target with Boulder Throw, then Pounce in and use Rumble to slow them so your carry can follow up. Once Inquisition and Stonewall are done, use Behemoth to stand in front of your team and soak hits.

howitzer:carry.Drop H11 Cluster Grenades to slow them,: Drop H11 Cluster Grenades to slow them and lob Land Mine to knock them back and stun, then poke with R2000 Missile from range. Once Combustion and Orion land, weave basic attacks between abilities so Armed Salvo refills your mana and keeps the rotation going.

legion:carry.Fire Saturation Charge to slow them, coo: Fire Saturation Charge to slow them, cook Frag Order to launch them, then keep shooting K-75 Storm Rifle while they're slowed. Once Sky Splitter and Spectra are done, drop Rally Point so your team moves faster, and aim Orbital Sanction at whoever runs.
legion:carry.Our read loses every listed carry lane,: Every listed carry wins this lane on our read, so farm near tower, avoid early trades, and save Rally Point for team fights.

grux:jungle.Gank with Stampede to drag them, then Sm: Gank with Stampede to drag them, then Smash 'n Grab to stun and Double Pain to heal while Bloodlust stacks. Once Viper lands near minute 16, use Warlord's Challenge on a hero with full Bloodlust stacks so hitting them keeps it going longer.

khaimera:offlane.Trade with basic attacks to build Rage,: Trade with basic attacks to build Rage, Ambush when they're low since it hits harder on missing health, then Unleash and hold Invigorate to cleanse their slows and heal. Once Manta Scythe and The Perforator are done, open fights with Cull on grouped enemies.

kira:carry.Stack Vengeance with Wrath and Mercy, th: Stack Vengeance with Wrath and Mercy, then pop Dusk to burst everyone marked, using Shadow Glide to dodge and reset it on takedowns. As Deathstalker and Viper land, fire Purge once the fight is committed and enemies are close, since it also cuts their healing.

mourn:jungle.Clear camps with Clobber so Extract keep: Clear camps with Clobber so Extract keeps your health up, then gank by channeling Abduct from out of sight and following with Beguile. Once Orion and Noxia are done, cast Eclipse before an objective fight so the enemy can't see your team coming.

neon:support.Land Data Burst on whoever dives your ca: Land Data Burst on whoever dives your carry, and save an Overclocked Data Burst to mesmerize them as well as slow them. As Warp Stream and Stonewall finish, use Final Thread in fights so L.I.N.X and Data Burst keep enemies off your carry.

revenant:offlane.Trade with Scar first so their bruiser g: Hit their bruiser with Scar and keep shooting so the stacks are used up and they get rooted, then back off while Fate reloads. Once Plasma Blade and Deathstalker are done, use Reckoning to isolate their carry in team fights instead of their frontline.

skylar:midlane.Poke with Plasma Grenade and Atomiser fr: Poke with Plasma Grenade from range, turn on Hypercharge to trade, and save Atomiser to finish a low target. After Viper and Deathstalker by minute 16, use Air Assault to fight from above and look for kills in side lanes.

yin:offlane.Pull in with Lash Kick, then chain basic: Pull in with Lash Kick, then chain basic attacks to proc Windburn and stack Rising Storm; use Backlash to push them away when they fight back. After Mutilator and The Perforator by minute 16, use Quelling Gale in team fights.

akeron:support.Riktor, Dekker and Phase beat this lane;: Riktor, Dekker and Narbash beat this lane; stay beside your carry and answer their engage instead of throwing Web Lash first.

bayle:support.Riktor, Dekker and Phase beat this lane;: Riktor, Dekker and Narbash beat this lane; let them engage first and answer with Cursed Edge instead of leaping in.

iggy-scorch:midlane.Plant Flame Turret near the wave, roll O: Plant Flame Turret near the wave, roll Oil Spill through the enemy, then ignite it with Molotov to burn them while your turrets keep firing. Once Orion and Wraith Leggings are done, hold Inferno for when they're slowed in the oil next to your turrets.

maco:support.Riktor, Dekker, Mourn and Phase win this: Riktor, Dekker, Mourn and Narbash win this lane on our read; stay behind your carry and save Maco Strike! to stop their engage.

muriel:support.Riktor, Dekker, Mourn and Phase win this: Riktor, Dekker, Mourn and Narbash win this lane on our read; don't charge Serenity in the open, stay behind your carry with Alacrity ready.

terra:support.Engage with Wild Rush, slow with Highlan: Engage with Wild Rush, slow with Highland Hurl, and let Ruthless Assault stack Hersir while your carry follows up. Once Stonewall and Raiment of Renewal are done by minute 19, stand in front and cast Unstoppable Force when you're slowed to cleanse it and gain armor for the fight.

valmont:support.Riktor, Dekker and Phase win this lane,: Riktor, Dekker and Narbash win this lane, so stop starting trades against them and stay behind your carry until your jungler arrives.

wukong:support.Engage with Windsurge to slow the enemy: Engage with Windsurge to slow the enemy duo, then use Cyclebreaker to take less damage while you stand in front of your carry, and land its staff throw to stun. Once Stonewall and Warden's Faith are done by minute 19, switch stance with 84000 Hairs and fight from the front.

note: the "checkpoints" swaps on revenant/riktor/serath apply the same ruling the critic made on eight other lanes (engine-internal vocabulary the UI never shows the reader); heroes named and actions advised are unchanged
